general.autoStartHint: Start Lenz quietly when you log in
general.checkUpdateHint: Check on launch and every 24 hours using GitHub Releases
general.openOnLaunchHint: When off, stays in the menu bar only
general.selectionIndicatorHint: Float a small icon at the cursor after selecting text; click to translate (needs Accessibility permission)
general.accessibilityRequired: The selection indicator needs Accessibility access. Refresh after granting it.
general.screenRecordingRequired: Screenshots and overlays need Screen Recording access.
general.selectionIndicatorWindowsHint: Float an icon at the cursor after selecting text; click to translate

shortcuts.selectionHint: Translate the text selected at the cursor
shortcuts.screenshotHint: Select a region, OCR, then show the translation
shortcuts.overlayHint: Render the translation right over the original pixels
shortcuts.recordingHint: Press the new shortcut; Backspace clears it and Esc cancels.
shortcuts.modifierRequired: Letter and number shortcuts need at least one modifier.
shortcuts.duplicate: This shortcut is already used by “{{name}}”.
shortcuts.permissionNote: Word translation needs macOS Accessibility permission; overlay needs Screen Recording. Both are requested on first use.
shortcuts.permissionWindows: Selection detection uses Windows UI Automation. OCR requires installed system language packs.

engines.desc: Enabled services show separate results in the popup. The default service is used for image overlays.
engines.emptyDesc: Add a local engine like LM Studio or Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible / cloud service.
engines.name: Name
engines.appleNote: Apple system translation is a placeholder — native bridge not wired yet, cannot test.
engines.maxTokensHint: Cap tokens in the response; blank = unlimited
engines.appleUnavailable: Apple Translation requires macOS 15 or later. Use OpenAI-compatible or cloud engines on this platform.
engines.appleReady: Uses on-device Apple Translation. First download the source and target languages in System Settings → General → Language & Region → Translation Languages. Connection tests use English as the source.
engines.appleLanguagesRequired: Required Apple translation languages are not installed. Open language settings, download both source and target languages, then retry (connection tests require English).
engines.appleTimeout: Apple Translation timed out. Check that both source and target languages have finished downloading, then retry. If installed, try increasing the timeout.
engines.timeoutHint: 1000–600000 ms. Download Apple translation languages in System Settings before translating.

ocr.servicesDesc: Select a service to edit. Set it as default to use it for screenshot translation.
ocr.visionModelPlaceholder: A model that supports image input
ocr.baiduCredentialsHint: Use the API Key and Secret Key from a Baidu AI Cloud OCR application, not Baidu Translation appid / secret credentials.
ocr.uploadNotice: Images are sent to this service for recognition. Tests send only the bundled sample image.
ocr.visionHint: Requires a Chat Completions API with image input. Used for screenshot translation only; overlay translation continues to use system OCR.
ocr.baiduHint: Returns text and locations for both screenshot and overlay translation.
ocr.systemServiceHint: Recognizes images locally for both screenshot and overlay translation.
ocr.testHint: Recognizes the bundled “LENZ OCR TEST 12345” sample without capturing your screen.
ocr.testFailed: Recognition failed. Check the service configuration and try again.
ocr.httpError: Service returned HTTP {{status}}. Check the URL, credentials, and service status.
ocr.baiduError: Baidu OCR error {{code}}. Check API access, quota, and recognition language.
ocr.timeoutHint: 1000–300000 ms. Vision models may need a longer timeout.

errors.ocr_invalid_timeout: Timeout must be between 1000 and 300000 ms.
errors.ocr_invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
errors.ocr_model_required: Enter a model name that supports image input.
errors.ocr_baidu_credentials: Enter the API Key and Secret Key for Baidu OCR.
errors.ocr_baidu_language: Choose a supported Baidu recognition language.
errors.ocr_baidu_auth: Baidu authentication failed. Check the API Key and Secret Key.
errors.ocr_invalid_response: Invalid response format. Check that the service supports the selected OCR protocol.
errors.ocr_incomplete_response: Model output was truncated or refused. Check the model and service settings.
errors.ocr_test_mismatch: The service responded but did not correctly recognize LENZ and 12345 in the sample.
errors.ocr_timeout: Recognition timed out. Increase the timeout and try again.
errors.ocr_network: Cannot connect to the OCR service. Check the URL and network.
errors.ocr_package_required: System OCR requires Windows MSIX package identity. Install Lenz and open it from the Start menu.
errors.ocr_unavailable: System OCR is unavailable. Check the recognition language packs.
errors.ocr_test_failed: Recognition test failed. Check the service configuration.

ocr.accuracyHint: “Accurate” is ~2× slower but handles small text
ocr.languagesDesc: Add or remove languages, then drag or use the arrows to change their priority.
ocr.backendWindowsHint: Windows system OCR requires the matching recognition language packs
ocr.systemAccuracy: Recognition strategy is managed by Windows OCR
ocr.systemConfidence: Windows OCR does not provide per-line confidence
ocr.systemFallback: Use system languages when preferred languages are unavailable
ocr.invalidLanguage: Enter a valid language tag, such as en-US, zh-Hans, or ja-JP.
ocr.windowsLanguages: Install recognition language packs in System Settings. Preferred languages are tried in order.
ocr.languageMissing: No installed OCR language packs were found.
ocr.languageRequired: Choose at least one installed language when system fallback is disabled.
ocr.autoDetectRequires13: Automatic language detection requires macOS 13 or later. This system uses the preferred recognition languages.
ocr.packageRequired: Install the Windows MSIX version and open Lenz from the Start menu to use system OCR.

about.privacy: System OCR runs locally. Third-party OCR sends images to your configured service, and cloud translation sends text. Lenz collects no analytics and requires no account.
about.noRelease: No accessible public release is available yet

overlay.title: Overlay translation
overlay.closeFailed: Could not close. Please try the close button again.
overlay.failed: Processing failed. Close and select the area again, or check your translation service settings.

popup.collapseHint: Without remembering, services expand on the next translation. Skipped services translate when expanded.
popup.preferenceSaveFailed: Could not save collapse preferences. Please try again.

error.noText: No text found. Try selecting again.
error.engineUnavailable: Service settings are incomplete or unavailable. Check the service configuration.
error.noEngines: No translation services are enabled. Enable a service in Settings.
error.captureTimeout: Screen capture timed out. Check screen recording permission and try again.
error.ocrTimeout: Text recognition timed out. Select a smaller area or try again later.
error.package_required: Install the Windows MSIX version and open Lenz from the Start menu to use system OCR.
